definitions.mu: Z_V^-1 exp(-V(x)) dx, actual normalized probability with positive finite normalizer derived from curvature
definitions.joint: pi_eta(dx dy) proportional exp(-V(x)-norm(x-y)^2/(2eta)) dxdy; actual X~mu, independent Z~N(0,I), Y+=X+sqrt(eta)Z,Y-=X-sqrt(eta)Z
definitions.marginal: nu=pi_eta^Y=mu*N(0,eta I); Y+ and Y- share nu and are exchangeable
definitions.reflection: U:(x,y)->(x,2x-y), measure-preserving involution; pullback on observables. P conditional resampling/expectation in x given y; U_PP=PUP, U_perpP=(I-P)UP
definitions.conditional: p_y(u)=Z_y^-1 exp(-W_y(u)), W_y(u)=V((y+u)/2)+norm(y-u)^2/(8eta); law of Y- given Y+=y. X=(y+u)/2, pushforward of unreflected RGO via u=2x-y, Lebesgue Jacobian2^-d; laws/operators/scales not identical
definitions.parameter_score: s_y(u)=-gradient V((y+u)/2)/2-(y-u)/(4eta)=-partial_y W_y(u); normalized parameter score is s_y-E_p_y s_y; s_y is not u-gradient log p_y
definitions.variance: Var_p(g)=integral (g-integral g dp)^2 dp for actual probability, covariance scalar-vector analog; no assumed zero mean of s_y
definitions.gradient: Euclidean gradient in parameter y for U_PP f(y); gradient in u for score observer. Their measures and variables remain distinct
definitions.norms: scalar/gradient L2 in nu; joint microscopic L2(pi_eta) for U_perpP f; AE equivalence classes per DefinitionD1
